reuse.why: Adds one guard to the existing link.ts module (next to findOrCreateBank) and every provider's link handler calls it; nothing in the tree already did this check.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the short call with provider, account id and upgradingId is repeated at the start of each of the five link handlers, which the per-provider handler structure requires.

placement.why: The query and error live in server/accounts/link.ts, the shared linking helper module, and run before any write in each handler.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and tests are added.

maintainability.why: A small, typed, documented helper keyed by provider; a future provider only needs one call and the rule changes in one place.

one_place.where: server/accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by the goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu and enableBanking link handlers.
